Optical computing encodes and processes information through the continuous evolution of optical fields, whereas digital electronic systems operate on discrete logical states. Conventional optical-to-electronic interfaces convert measured optical responses into electronically accessible data, with task-specific interpretation subsequently performed in the electronic domain.
